core.headline: Mid-terrace house, Wren Close, Dartford – Shared Ownership
core.summary: Shared Ownership mid-terrace house in Dartford with two bedrooms, rear garden, two parking spaces and gas central heating. Lease 990 years; service charge £312 per year. 40% share for £130,000.
core.listing:
A mid-terrace house with two bedrooms at Wren Close, Dartford DA1. The price is £130,000 for a 40% share. Rent on the unsold share is £487 per month. The full market value is £325,000. The tenure is leasehold with 990 years remaining. Ground rent is peppercorn. The service charge is £312 per year, a 2026/27 estimate.

The ground floor has a reception room. The first floor has two bedrooms and a bathroom. The property has gas central heating. There is a rear garden. Parking comprises a driveway with two spaces.

Wren Close is in Dartford DA1. Electricity, water and sewerage are mains. Water is metered. Broadband is FTTC. Mobile signal offers good outdoor coverage on major networks.

The price is Shared Ownership £130,000 for a 40% share. Rent on the unsold share is £487 per month. The full market value is £325,000. The tenure is leasehold with 990 years remaining, peppercorn ground rent and a service charge of £312 per year, a 2026/27 estimate. Council Tax is band C, Dartford Borough Council. The EPC rating is B. Construction is standard. Shared ownership eligibility criteria apply. The housing association has an 8-week nomination period on resale.
